_doc: What each nightly visual smoke scene must show (visual_check.py; docs/ci/nightly-next-canary.md).
Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] fractions of the captured window (1000x640 points, CMUX_NEXT_TEST_WINDOW_FRAME).
edge: share of pixels with a visible step to a neighbour on a 640-px grayscale copy; text and controls
score about 0.02-0.08, an empty or flat area under 0.001. Changing a limit or a reference is a reviewed
change to this folder: there is no switch that skips the gate.
min_ssim applies only when references/<scene>.png exists (32x20 grid; same layout ~0.97, another scene 0.3-0.7).
